title: incident-bot: oncall autodiagnostics contextual summaries and runbook linking
author: Aisha Patel
commits: initial: add contextual summary pipeline and summarizer interface
fix: handle nil metadata in summary enrichments
docs: describe runbook linking and examples
description: Adds a contextual summary layer to incident-bot autodiagnostics that produces concise, on-call friendly summaries and automatically links to relevant runbooks. Motivation: during on-call rotations teams need quick actionable context and runbook pointers surfaced directly in pager messages and channel summaries. This change implements a summarizer pipeline that leverages existing SLO/context heuristics, adds a lightweight scoring function to rank runbook candidates, and surfaces the top 1-3 runbook links with short rationale. Checklist: - implement summarizer interface and concrete contextual summarizer - integrate summarizer into autodiagnostics flow - add runbook candidate scorer and link extractor - add unit tests and e2e smoke test - update docs with examples and operator notes Related: ENG-1897 (autodiag improvements), SUP-4121 (oncall support followup).
review_comments: Priya Rao: Can we guarantee the scorer won't surface stale runbooks? Suggest adding last-modified threshold or annotation filter.
Aisha Patel: Added a filter to exclude runbooks with `archived: true` and a 180-day last-modified cutoff; rationale added to docs.
Ethan Kim: There was a flaky test in summarizer_test due to time-dependent sampling; please use test clock or freeze time.
Aisha Patel: Switched to deterministic test clock in summarizer_test and reduced nondeterminism in sampling.
Marta Novak: Approve after docs update and a small nits cleanup.
CI: build passed on rerun; integration test incident-bot-e2e flaked once due to networking timeout, reran and passed.
release_notes: Enhancement: autodiagnostics now include concise contextual summaries and automatic runbook linking to speed on-call resolution. See docs/runbooks.md for operator notes and configuration.
